description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes related to environment variable management within the lighttpd server, including environment initialization, setting, retrieval, duplication, and cleanup.

methods.name: li_environment_init
methods.description: Initializes a new environment by creating its internal hash table.

methods.name: li_environment_reset
methods.description: Resets the environment by removing all entries.

methods.name: li_environment_clear
methods.description: Clears and destroys the environment's hash table.

methods.name: li_environment_set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the environment, overwriting existing entries.

methods.name: li_environment_insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the environment without overwriting existing data.

methods.name: li_environment_remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key and its associated value from the environment.

methods.name: li_environment_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from the environment.

methods.name: li_environment_make_dup
methods.description: Creates a read-only duplicate of the current environment.

methods.name: li_environment_dup_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for an environment duplicate.

methods.name: li_environment_dup_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a value from the duplicated environment for a specified key.

methods.name: li_environment_dup2cgi
methods.description: Transfers environment variables to CGI variables, prioritizing duplicated environment values where present.
